headline: Oracle files to sell $20 billion in new stock, bonds to finance AI buildout
detail: This signals significant investment in AI infrastructure by a major player. It could be a positive for the broader AI ecosystem, but also suggests increased supply of related securities.
rec: Monitor Oracle's stock movement and any related semiconductor or cloud infrastructure companies.

headline: Crude oil prices sell off more than 7% on Iran peace talk hopes
detail: A sharp drop in oil prices can sometimes correlate with broader market risk-off sentiment. This could indirectly impact tech if investors rotate out of riskier assets.
rec: This headline doesn't directly suggest a specific trade for your tech-heavy book.

headline: CrowdStrike lands an upgrade
detail: A positive analyst action for a cybersecurity name. While not a chip stock, it shows some individual names are still getting attention.
rec: This is a positive note for CRWD, but doesn't necessitate a change in your current position.

headline: These tech stocks got unfairly swept up in last week’s selloff, analysts say
detail: This suggests some analysts believe certain tech names are oversold. It could be a signal for potential short-term bounces if sentiment shifts.
rec: Keep an eye on the broader tech sentiment and see if any of your holdings show signs of recovery.
